news_list.title: Revival 0.4.0
news_list.short_description: Quest fixes (the candles, Thorstein, the mushrooms, the Intruder's endings), oils at full strength, smoother fights, fairer shop prices and packs that show what was inside.
news_list.content:
What changed in 0.4.0:

SHOP
- New prices for casual play (the Revival preset): potions, oils and bombs cost a half to two thirds of what they did, bait 150 gold coins, ingredients and crafting stations about 40% less, swords and armor a quarter less, and bags half.
- Daily deals are 40% off (25% before).
- Chests are always a bargain: each costs about a quarter less than what is inside. A little something costs 90 gold coins, For professionals 280.
- Two new chests: Scrolls and bombs (2 Lesser Summoning Scrolls, 3 Grapeshot and 3 Dancing Star) and Set of bait (one of each bait).
- Every price is on the Rewards page of the dashboard. The Vanilla preset keeps the original prices.

PACKS
- A Herbalist's pack holds more: three finds, roots most often, also herbs and powdered monster tissue, and now and then monster remains.
- Opening packs in the inventory shows what was inside, one item at a time.
- A pack from a friend shows its rarest find, and the rest goes into your inventory with it.
- What a pack holds is on the Rewards page of the dashboard. In the Vanilla preset it holds herbs or roots, as its description says.
- Opening your last pack takes you back to the inventory (its window no longer comes back offering Open).

QUESTS
- The Sins of Our Fathers: each candle now burns out after its 15 minutes and the next one can be lit, so the curse can be lifted.
- Thorstein's Conversation button now starts his part in The Sins of Our Fathers and in Intruder.
- The Great Mushrooming: the mushrooms show even while another quest is tracked, one after every 100 m walked (200 m in the original game).
- Intruder: every ending can now be reached; deal with the frightener before the sorcerer's 24 hours are up for the best reward. Its 24-hour wait now ends as it should.

COMBAT
- Oils now give their full bonus: a 33% oil makes a blow 33% stronger, on top of weaknesses, potions and skills. The Vanilla preset keeps the original sum, and the oils' descriptions say so.
- Perfect parries pay their experience again once Hit Reflection is learnt.
- A level-up window that was missed (the game closed, the connection dropped) now shows after the next start.

SMOOTHER PLAY
- Fights and encounters start at once: they no longer wait behind the map's slower requests.
- Less work for the phone while you play: the game's most frequent calls skip the hook's script, and inland map tiles are drawn faster.

DASHBOARD AND APP
- Players: choose your character's gender and head; the game shows it at its next start.
- Tuning: new settings for oils, deflected blows, the walking between mushrooms, finds of untracked quests and the Intruder's endings, each with its original value in the Vanilla preset.
- Save Data: a restore checks the file first and leaves your progress as it was if anything is wrong. Stop the server before restoring.

GOOD TO KNOW
- This update changes the game itself: tap Update the game in the companion app.
- New prices apply once the server and the game start again.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors. Questions and reports: join our Discord from the companion app.
